moany.definition:
Love-sickness induced from talking to extremely beautiful twins causing one to lose themselves in incredibly happy daydreams of romance.

Side Effects Include: Daydreaming, drooling, constant giggling, blushing, beaming and skyrocketing phone bills.
> Dave: Dude, I totally can't stop thinking about the [twins]. They are so hot!
> Ben: Yeah man, I totally got the moanies going on so tough right now. They drive me crazy.
